Dawn C API Android `.so` (NativeGpu / `GpuBackends.dawn()`).

Pin matches `androidx.webgpu:webgpu:1.0.0-alpha05` AAR
`assets/dawn_build_metadata.json` → `dawn_source_commit_sha`:

  9d41fdf36977cca92361c6ae2769129bbaaafd9b

Upstream: https://dawn.googlesource.com/dawn (GitHub mirror https://github.com/google/dawn)
License: BSD-3-Clause (see LICENSE in this directory). Same renderer as
androidx JNI leftover — C API adapter, not a second Dawn (NG-7).

Recipe (does **not** git-add any `.so`):

  python3 ./scripts/build-dawn-c-android.py --probe-aar
  python3 ./scripts/build-dawn-c-android.py --build --targets arm64-v8a x86_64
  .\scripts\build-dawn-c-android.ps1 -ProbeAar
  .\scripts\build-dawn-c-android.ps1 -Build -Targets arm64-v8a,x86_64

`--probe-aar` downloads the published AAR into `.cache/` (gitignored) and
records JNI leftover size + missing `webgpu.h` exports.
`--build` needs NDK `28.2.13676358` and writes
`out/<abi>/libwebgpu_dawn.so` plus generated `webgpu.h` under `install/`.

Press (GAV 0.1.1+) runs `--build` and packs the `.so` into the `host-dawn`
AAR. Consumers of `android-webgpu` / `host-dawn` do not rebuild Dawn.
Cloud CI assemble without the recipe stays table-backed.

Do not git-add `libwebgpu_c_bundled.so` (already inside androidx.webgpu).
Do not ship androidx bundled + this C API `.so` together in the default APK.
`--prebuilt` (Google dated Android `.a`) is not the press path (different SHA).
